description: Line-of-sight visibility analysis for SPICE bodies over terrain (React).

descriptionFull.title: Computes and visualizes line-of-sight visibility to orbiting or celestial targets over terrain.

sources.name: User-friendly name for orbiter or body
sources.value: NAIF SPICE Spacecraft name or ID

observers.name: User-friendly name for observer for spacecraft time computations. Set to null to turn off time converting.
observers.type: Optional. 'lsmt' for lunar local solar mean time.

name: Sightline

components.name: DEM path
components.description: A path to a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) DEM relative to the mission directory. Used to compute terrain occlusion and elevation profiles. Large DEMs must be COGs for acceptable performance.

components.name: Sources
components.description: An array of objects with the properties 'name' and 'value'. 'name' is the display name for the Source Entity dropdown. 'value' is the SPICE spacecraft ID that gets passed to the backend sightmap.py script. Ensure the right kernels for the configured source entities/targets exist in /private/api/spice/kernels.

object.name: Name
object.description: Display name for the Source Entity dropdown.

object.name: SPICE Value
object.description: NAIF SPICE Spacecraft name or ID passed to the backend.

components.name: Observers
components.description: An array of objects with the properties 'name', 'value', 'frame', and 'body'. 'name' is the display name for the Observer dropdown. 'value' is the SPICE spacecraft ID that gets passed to the backend chronice time conversion scripts. Ensure the right kernels for the configured observers exist in /private/api/spice/kernels and that there is a proper chronos setup file for each observer's value at private/api/spice/chronosSetups/chronos-{lowercased_observer_value}.setup.

object.name: Name
object.description: Display name for the Observer dropdown.

object.name: SPICE Value
object.description: SPICE spacecraft ID passed to the backend chronice scripts.

components.name: Default Height (m)
components.description: Sets a default for the 'Height' parameter. Height in meters above the surface to use when calculating line-of-sight visibility. For instance, a point on the surface (0m) may not be visible to a 'Source Entity', say the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO), but 2m above that point may be. This value does not only apply to the center longitude and latitude but to all points on the visible terrain. Gradually increasing this value shows the sightmap n-meters above the surface. The regular default is 0 meters.

components.name: Observer Time Placeholder
components.description: Placeholder text shown in observer time inputs. Use a format string that matches the observer's time system (e.g. SOL-ddddMhh:mm:ss for Mars sols, LDAY-NNNNNLHH:MM:SS for lunar local solar time).

author: NASA-AMMOS/MMGIS
